def VTask.piEquivPiSubtypeProd {α : Type _} (p : α → Prop) (β : α → Type _) [DecidablePred p] : 
  ((i : α) → β i) ≃ ((i : {x // p x}) → β ↑i) × ((i : {x // ¬p x}) → β ↑i) where
  toFun := λ f => (λ (s : {x // p x}) => f s.1, λ (s : {x // ¬p x}) => f s.1)
  invFun := λ (g, h) => λ (i : α) => if hi : p i then g ⟨i, hi⟩ else h ⟨i, hi⟩
  left_inv := by
    intro f
    ext i
    by_cases hi : p i
    · simp [toFun, invFun, hi]
      rfl
    · simp [toFun, invFun, hi]
      rfl
  right_inv := by
    intro ⟨g, h⟩
    cases ⟨g, h⟩
    apply Prod.eq
    · ext (s : {x // p x})
      simp [invFun, toFun, s.2]
      rfl
    · ext (s : {x // ¬p x})
      simp [invFun, toFun, s.2]
      rfl
